title: Tighten logit softcap 15 -> 10
description: One line in GPT.forward: softcap = 15 -> 10; nothing else touched.
reflection: FLAT. val_bpb 0.986502 vs baseline 0.986277, i.e. +0.00023 -- a quarter of the ~0.0009 noise floor, so a tie, not a loss. Confound-free as promised: params 71.3M, peak VRAM 32.9GB, 328.3M tokens / 2505 steps, MFU 38.1%, final smoothed train loss ~2.769, all indistinguishable from baseline. Reading: softcap 15 sits at/near the optimum of a strongly ASYMMETRIC curve -- loosening to 30 cost 0.004 in five independent runs, tightening to 10 costs nothing. So the round-6 penalty was not 'we are on a slope pointing downhill'; it was a cliff on the loose side only. The cap is load-bearing but its exact value is not a tuning lever anywhere in 10-15. Output head is closed.
